title: diagnostic cabling, connectors and organized service routing

specimens.name: Slotted wiring-duct segment with routed harness
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Short gray slotted cable/wiring duct with snap-on lid edge and a neatly routed multi-core insulated harness retained inside; short fragment only, no full cabinet or wall.

specimens.name: Braided multi-core harness branch with heat-shrink breakout
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Compact dark braided electrical harness fragment splitting into three controlled branches through molded/heat-shrink breakout sleeves and identical strain-relief clamps; no labels or loose random wires.

specimens.name: Shielded coaxial diagnostic cable segment
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Short flexible shielded test-cable segment with matching metal bayonet/coax connectors at both ends and molded strain reliefs; one cable only, no instrument, label or panel.

specimens.name: Circular multipin bayonet connector pair with short tails
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Matching industrial/aerospace-style circular multipin plug and receptacle connected only to very short harness tails, with knurled locking shells and strain reliefs; no equipment panel or labels.

specimens.name: Grouped sealed cable-gland bulkhead pass-through
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. Small metal bulkhead plate fragment containing four identical sealed cable glands in an even pattern, each with only a very short cable stub; no full enclosure or wall.

specimens.name: Stainless instrumentation-tubing elbow and compression union
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. Short clean stainless tube fragment with one precise 90-degree bend and one double-ferrule compression union; no valve, gauge or surrounding pipe network.

specimens.name: Crimped service hose with quick-disconnect coupling
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. Short reinforced black hose with factory-crimped ferrule, one compact quick-disconnect fluid coupling and molded bend relief; no manifold or complete hydraulic system.

specimens.name: Compact solenoid manifold with dedicated diagnostic/test ports
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. Small machined metal manifold block with several standardized fluid ports, two compact solenoid coil housings and two capped diagnostic/test ports; no hoses, wires, gauges or control cabinet.

global_forbidden: text, letters, numbers, logos, cable labels, heat-shrink lettering or pseudo-writing
loose random wiring, open twisted wire bundles, improvised junctions or uncontrolled cable loops
complete cable racks, complete wiring cabinets, full hydraulic/pneumatic systems, tanks, pumps, machines, buildings, rooms or scenes
any ninth or extra specimen, duplicate specimen, omitted specimen, merged specimen or substitution
gauges, control panels, CRTs/displays, lamps or whole diagnostic instruments
generic E1 perforated tray and P-clamp routing as the only cable language; plain conduit elbow or ordinary pipe flange as dominant specimens
baked cast shadows, contact shadows, glow, bloom, rays or temporary FX
photorealistic product-catalog rendering, filtered 3D render or soft studio photography

era_contract.character: late-1990s test-center infrastructure with explicitly routed harnesses, braided branch breakouts, shielded diagnostic cabling, sealed multipin interfaces, precision instrumentation tubing and service/test ports
required_signals: multipin locking connectors and sealed bulkhead glands
quick-disconnect service couplings and diagnostic manifold ports
replaced_previous_language: E1 generic cable trays and parallel P-clamped bundles as the primary routing vocabulary
ordinary conduit elbows and pipe flanges
solenoid manifolds without explicit service/test interfaces
forbidden_regressions: E1-only routing without diagnostic connector/test-port language
